tldr: Midday batch, Aug 6: the open-weight wave keeps rolling — Moonshot's Kimi K3 (2.8T, largest open model ever), Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max with the QwenWork agent platform, MiniMax's H3 video model, and FrontisAI's open 'AI4AI' meta-evolution agent. OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 prices up to 80% while its internal Astra model posts Lean-4-certified results on ten long-open math problems. Funding stays frothy: OLIX $312M at $3.3B for optical inference silicon, Zenity $125M for agent security, Convex $57M, and China's Fangqing above $1.5B pre-silicon. Moonshot packages K3 into Kimi Slides, Cisco ships open-weight security SLMs, Gemini Spark goes global with Chrome web errands, and Dario Amodei reiterates Anthropic's no-ban stance on open weights.

articles.title: Moonshot Releases Kimi K3 — Largest Open-Weight Model Ever (2.8T)
articles.summary: Moonshot ships Kimi K3, largest open-weight model: 2.8T params, 1M context, hybrid linear attention; tops Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 in coding.

articles.title: Alibaba Unveils Qwen3.8-Max With QwenWork Agent Platform
articles.summary: Alibaba unveils Qwen3.8-Max: 2.4T-param MoE, 1M context, native vision; open weights + Qwen3.8-27B next week; QwenWork platform in beta.

articles.title: OpenAI Cuts GPT-5.6 Prices Up to 80%
articles.summary: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 prices: Luna −80% to $0.20/$1.20 per M tokens, Terra −20%; Sol gets Fast mode; ARC-AGI-3 up to 38.3% with 6x fewer output tokens.

articles.title: OpenAI's Astra Model Posts Proofs on Ten Open Math Problems
articles.summary: OpenAI's Astra model posts Lean-4-certified results on ten open math problems: sphere packing, Ramsey numbers, Connes' rigidity conjecture.

articles.title: MiniMax Open-Sources H3 Video Generation Model
articles.summary: MiniMax open-sources H3 video generation (Base + Regenerate-2K) with sparse-attention training; Context-IR stays API-only under H3 Community License.

articles.title: FrontisAI Open-Sources 'AI4AI' Meta-Evolution Agent (35B)
articles.summary: FrontisAI open-sources Frontis-MA1 (35B), an 'AI4AI' agent for ML engineering; lifts MLE-Bench Lite medals from 39% to 61% on one RTX 4090.

articles.title: Cisco Launches Antares Open-Weight Security SLMs
articles.summary: Cisco launches Antares: open-weight security SLMs for vulnerability discovery in AI code — 1B for laptops, gated 3B frontier-level on one GPU.

articles.title: OLIX Raises $312M at $3.3B for Optical Inference Silicon
articles.summary: OLIX raises $312M at $3.3B (Arm, Hudson River, Hastings) for X-1 optical inference — no HBM, targeting 10K+ tokens/sec; shipments H2 2027.

articles.title: Zenity Raises $125M for AI-Agent Security and Governance
articles.summary: Zenity raises $125M Series C (Norwest, SoftBank Vision Fund 2) for AI-agent security and governance as agent rollouts hit critical systems.

articles.title: Convex Raises $57M for the 'Reliable Backend for the AI Era'
articles.summary: Convex raises $57M (Insight Partners) for AI-era backends; claims 90% of AI-built apps on traditional databases silently corrupt vs 0% on Convex.

articles.title: Moonshot Demos Kimi Slides, Powered by Kimi K3
articles.summary: Moonshot's Kimi Slides turns research into editable PowerPoint decks (native charts, SmartArt) in Kimi Work, powered by Kimi K3.

articles.title: Shanghai's Fangqing Tops $1.5B Pre-Silicon on Decoupled AI Chips
articles.summary: Shanghai's Fangqing tops $1.5B pre-silicon (state-backed A1 round) with decoupled attention/FFN chips for agent inference under US export controls.

articles.title: Amodei Reiterates Anthropic's No-Ban Stance on Open Weights
articles.summary: Amodei: Anthropic 'has never advocated' open-weight bans; pushes chip export controls, distillation crackdown, pre-release safety tests.

articles.title: Gemini Spark Goes Global With Chrome 'Web Errands'
articles.summary: Gemini Spark expands to 160+ countries and gains Chrome 'web errands' — booking, scheduling, research via saved logins, with injection protections.

articles.title: OpenAI Retires the DALL·E GPT in ChatGPT
articles.summary: OpenAI retires the DALL·E GPT in ChatGPT on Aug 30, folding image gen into ChatGPT Images; ~30 days left to download saved images.

articles.title: Chips and Cheese Pokes a Hole in NVIDIA's Vera Whitepaper
articles.summary: Chips & Cheese questions NVIDIA's Vera whitepaper interconnect claims; 104 points and 14 comments on Hacker News.

articles.title: LocalLLaMA Nostalgia: When 'Flash' Meant 32B
articles.summary: LocalLLaMA nostalgia: 'flash' went from 32B models to DeepSeek V4 Flash with 1M context — fans hope such capabilities reach home hardware.
